title: spectrl: URL-safe interchange for mass spectra
description: spectrl defines and implements a URL-safe interchange format for individual mass spectra. A spectrl2 token contains peak arrays, precursor information, modeled metadata based on mzML controlled-vocabulary terms, and an optional ProForma interpretation. The payload is encoded as CBOR and Base64url text with an integrity hash. Peak arrays can use MS-Numpress compression or lossless floating-point storage. Because the spectrum is carried in the token, it can be placed in URL fragments, query parameters, data URIs, QR codes, notebooks, and publication supplements without requiring a repository lookup or application backend. The Python package provides encoding, decoding, validation, URL helpers, a command-line interface, and conversion from mzmlpy spectrum objects. An independent TypeScript implementation supports browsers and Node, and shared conformance vectors test agreement between the two implementations. spectrl is intended for self-contained spectrum exchange and application handoffs. Repository-based identifiers remain more appropriate when persistent archival lookup is the primary goal.
